title: Upgrading a CockroachDB cluster
brief: Rehearse CockroachDB’s binary rollout and cluster-version boundary with explicit return limits.
outcomes: Distinguish mixed binaries from finalised compatibility
Verify rollback eligibility, application acceptance and recovery choices
entry: General cluster change, CockroachDB ranges, secure operations including the prepared node-health branch, and backups.

heading.title: Version and compatibility
heading.brief: Pin a supported source/target transition and official route; treat the inventory’s 25.3.7→25.4.17 as a historical rehearsal clue, not a current release claim.

heading.title: Before the rollout
heading.brief: Use RL128’s node-health branch with its RL123/RL109 preparation. Verify backups, health, unsupported features, active jobs and downgrade gates; establish the intended pause before automatic finalisation if supported.

heading.title: Mixed binaries
heading.brief: Roll owned nodes within documented constraints and return one to the old binary only while permitted; observe cluster and application behaviour.

heading.title: The finalisation boundary
heading.brief: Finalise deliberately when eligible, test documented old-binary refusal safely and explain why later return requires recovery or migration rather than replacing binaries.
